text:
Grandma's weeknight chili (the one everyone asks for!)

Okay, before we get to the good stuff: this chili has been in our family since the 90s and it has saved more Tuesday nights than I can count. Don't skip the resting step, trust me. Scroll down for the printable card!

Serves 6 | Prep 15 min | Cook 1 hr

1 lb ground beef
1 large onion, chopped
3 cloves garlic, minced
2 cans kidney beans, drained
1 can diced tomatoes
250 ml beef stock
100g red bell pepper, diced
a pinch of cayenne pepper
salt to taste

Brown the beef in a big pot, breaking it up as it cooks. Add the onion, garlic and pepper and cook until soft, about 5 minutes. Stir in the tomatoes, beans and stock, then simmer uncovered for 45 minutes. Season with the cayenne and salt and let it rest for 10 minutes before serving.
